says: After build.ts replaces <home>/build by rename, the running stage serves that build once and then no longer sees later changes to the folder
proof: review probe on a temp home: append before the swap re-served with a new pid; append after the swap gave no Rebuilding line and the same pid; not tried on the unpatched watcher
cost: a second rebuild into a running stage is silently ignored until a restart

says: A `// oxlint-disable-next-line` comment for a rule that is on only in the .agents/ block cannot be used in .agents/ code, though decision 0033 says edges there use the same comment as next/: oxlint also reads each file through its .claude/skills link, where that block does not apply, and reports the comment as unused, which blocks.
proof: With 12 such comments for fabrika/no-why-key in .agents/skills/lead/scripts/drive.ts, drive.test.ts and box.test.ts, `node oxlint-plugins/lint.ts` printed 12 lines of the form `.claude/skills/lead/scripts/drive.ts:320:2 Unused oxlint-disable directive (no problems were reported).` and `oxlint: 13 blocking`; without the comments the same 12 lines were reported under .agents/ as fabrika(no-why-key).
cost: Every rule that fits .agents/ badly on one line needs a ledger entry and the owner's yes instead of a marked edge, and each file under .agents/skills is linted twice.

proof: CI job e2e on pull request 664 at head ecb96ccc printed `locator.waitFor: Timeout 30000ms exceeded ... waiting for getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Keyboard shortcuts' })` at apps/fabrika/e2e.ts:2691 (https://github.com/usirin/tea-fabrika/actions/runs/42784536523/job/129722646848). The same job passed on the head before it, e627f230, and the commits between them change only field rows, the glossary, decisions and one docs line.
cost: A red e2e on a pull request that did not cause it holds its merge, and a rerun hides the race.
